classification: Warm-restart diagnostic. The original source path runs continuously to the .4938 s trigger; then eight same-time alpha/MULES, momentum/thermo-refresh/pressure maps execute. This is not a physical continuation or discharge prediction.

mechanical_map.alpha_operator: At each sweep reuse stock alphaControls.H and compressibleAlphaEqnSubCycle.H, including the configured alpha predictor, full Sp+divU source, compression flux and MULES correction.
assertions: PIMPLE corr remains 8 and finalIter remains true
exactly two pressure correctors per sweep
mechanical_map.classification: diagnostic only; do not accumulate same-time iterations as elapsed time or discharged mass
evolving: pressure, velocity, phi, phase densities/psi, K, and Gamma as derived by source order
held: shared common T exact field hash
all materialized Euler oldTime histories, including alpha1 and alpha2
alphaPhi1 old-time level count; no alphaPhi1.oldTime accessor is invoked
mechanical_map.phase_continuity: Capture stock pEqn pre/post-EOS water/gas continuity records for each pressure pass and label map sweep; report per-sweep phase inventory state changes separately, without treating repeated maps as physical mass transfer.
mechanical_map.phase_temperature_rule: Every internal and boundary phase-T value must remain within 128*epsilon*max(1,abs(trigger value)); common T remains exact. Re-derived phase T differences are recorded numerically rather than required byte-identical.
mechanical_map.raw_floor: At first raw pressure below unchanged pMin, use the existing no-clamp diagnostic censor path, preserve trigger/offending raw records, and stop; no stock clamp or continued map.
source_order: stock alphaPhi1, alpha2, rhoPhi, rho, and contErr construction
fixed-common-T mixture.correctThermo()/mixture.correct() at the original post-TEqn slot, with phase-T bound assessment
two stock transonic pressure correctors and EOS/U/K/Gamma updates

output_metrics: max abs delta alphaPhi1, phi, and rhoPhi including boundaries
same-time water/gas inventory changes (not accumulated discharge)
stock pEqn phase continuity L1/max pre/post-EOS by mapped sweep
T phase delta, common-T hash, held-state hashes, oldTime levels
